title: Decision: state_version stamped at write time for efficient get_changes_since
description: message.rs lines 86-88 advance the state counter BEFORE inserting the message, and store the returned version in state_version column. This allows get_changes_since (line 307) to query WHERE state_version > since_version without scanning timestamps or maintaining a separate changelog table. Efficient, simple, deterministic. Rejected alternative: stamping at query time would require tracking both read and write state separately.
